numerics.cross_architecture_reproducibility: measured, sm_70 vs sm_120 (T25, results/T25/, decisions/D001): NOT bitwise portable -- 0.12% of pairs bit-identical after 100 Adagrad steps, |dT_shape| p99 2.6e-5 overall and 3.6e-7 on the T>=0.7 stratum -- but bit-identical at a fixed pose (steps=0), and the ranked output is unchanged: top-1 and top-5 set and order identical for 480/480 queries. sm_70 is outside the sm_80+ deploy library, so this bounds the effect rather than predicting Ampere-Blackwell.
